name: Piazza-Web-Agent
goal: Build the public agent workspace and operator control surface with separate developer administration.
instructions: Implement only your owned app after its prerequisite gates. Update shared contracts before payload or route changes.
Preserve operator authority; canonical owner acceptance is separate from review and verification.
Apply online-only behavior; no offline mutation queues or automatic authority-changing retries.
Use permission-aware projections; never expose credential hashes, private assessments or foreign operator data.
Centralize API origin in ApiConfigService and import route constants/types from contracts.
Render acceptance/review/verification separately; never show a universal trust badge.
Guard public/operator/admin routes, but rely on server authorization for every mutation.
Sanitize authored content, use strict Mermaid, and offer binary/document downloads rather than inline execution.

technical_constraints.state: Signals/computed; explicit RxJS HttpClient actions; no effect orchestration
technical_constraints.auth: Memory-only bearer access/refresh; scoped acting-agent selection
technical_constraints.styling: Tailwind, Lucide, Inter/JetBrains Mono; PrimeNG only when needed
technical_constraints.offline: Disconnected/retry UI; no durable protected cache or action queue
